reviewScope: All 827 photographs fully decoded and visually reviewed in 13 chronological contact sheets. All 83 shortlisted photographs checked again in larger comparison sheets at up to 492 pixels; covers opened at 1,000 pixels.  Videos and hidden metadata sidecars remain outside the still-photo album.
locationNotes: Original GPS, visible signs and chronological capture order establish Margaret’s Deck, Ghum, Darjeeling, Chowrasta, the Peace Pagoda, zoo and Himalayan Mountaineering Institute.
The red station photographed along the road at 27.0083 N, 88.2542 E retains a broad hill railway road label, rather than assigning Kurseong from the overall approach.
The natural history museum is supported by the photographed displays, source GPS and the zoo’s official facilities listing.
All selected frames retain original DateTimeOriginal and +05:30 offset. Undated edited copies and pre-arrival train photographs are omitted.
People and some personal scenes are included without identifying or matching faces; their source filenames are listed for owner review.
criteria: Select distinct scenery, architecture, wildlife, food, details and daily life; omit most posed portrait bursts and visually repeated views.
Aim for around ten strong photographs per day/location where available; do not pad shorter stops.
Use the cover once outside the gallery, counted on its actual capture day.
Preserve original framing and colour; correct orientation. Export quality-84 WebP at up to 2,000 pixels long edge, 2,400 for the cover. Retain source ICC profiles; omit EXIF/XMP.
Keep originals, videos, sidecars, review sheets and credentials outside Git and R2.
